_source: BUG-696 (2026-11-09): an author-year citation that names its source in another spelling than the reference entry was reported missing from the reference list. Measured on the stored dev theses: DESTAMP cites 'Xiongbin (2017)' for the entry 'Xiong-Bin, W. et al. (2017)' and 'Statista Research Department (2023)' for 'Statista. (2023)'; two blind raters judged both the same work. Only a citation the main matching left without an entry is considered, only against an entry nothing else cites, and only when exactly one entry fits.
_fold_note: Characters dropped before two names are compared: 'Xiong-Bin' and 'Xiongbin' are one name.
_organisation_note: An organisation written in a short and a long form ('Statista', 'Statista Research Department'): one name's words begin the other's. Only when the entry's author is written as an organisation (no 'Surname, Initials' comma), and only when the citing sentence carries the entry's title: at least title_evidence_min_words of its title words, and at least title_evidence_min_share of them. A personal surname never matches this way.
